notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic land.
Power Artifact attached to Pili-Pala.
description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pili-Pala, untapping the basic land.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
